decisions.decision: A page is a directory whose own files hold >= 10 named definitions, named by its path minus a leading src/ (root = repo name)
decisions.why: matches the user's flask/json example without per-language import paths
decisions.rejected: a page per file; <repo>/<last component>; Python dotted module names

decisions.decision: Store docs at ingestion: Chunk.doc and a file doc from the same parse, EXTRACT_VERSION 2 backfill
decisions.why: module docstrings and Go doc comments are outside the stored chunks, and the existing re-read keeps unchanged symbols so nothing is re-embedded
decisions.rejected: reading the working tree at compile time; widening Go chunks to include comments

decisions.decision: Deterministic Markdown pages: structural sentence, quoted docs, key symbols ranked by external callers with types first, imports grouped by directory
decisions.why: no model and no outside service (constitution I, user confirmed); every statement comes from the index
decisions.rejected: language model prose; per-language prose templates

decisions.decision: Citations are rows with FKs to ccctx_symbols and ccctx_files ON DELETE SET NULL, recording commit and content hash
decisions.why: cascade would silently drop the citation of an edited symbol, which ingestion deletes and reinserts; set-null keeps the evidence of staleness
decisions.rejected: on delete cascade; stored name and path re-resolved at read time

decisions.decision: Mark stale inside the ingest transaction; recompile after commit in a separate transaction
decisions.why: readers never see new code beside a page called fresh, and a wiki failure cannot roll back an ingestion
decisions.rejected: recompile inside the ingest transaction; recompile on the next ingestion; read-time staleness only

decisions.decision: Pages get their own table and second hybrid index; page hits placed above the first non-definition hit with lower semantic similarity
decisions.why: fused RRF scores of two indexes are not comparable, cosine similarity from the same model is; the definitions block stays first
decisions.rejected: pages as rows of ccctx_symbols; one shared search table (re-embeds everything); re-fusing both lists ourselves

decisions.decision: read_wiki(page?, repo?) lists or reads; search hits gain state and nullable line range; version 1.1.0
decisions.why: additive contract changes are MINOR; one tool keeps the tool list short
decisions.rejected: a separate list_wiki tool; a fake 1..n line range for pages

decisions.decision: A question naming '<name> module|package|directory' puts that page first
decisions.why: SC-005: a docs chunk outranked the flask/json page on similarity alone
decisions.rejected: boosting all page hits, which would bury exact-identifier answers

decisions.decision: Key symbols rank code before tests, then outside callers, exported, documented, total callers, name; names de-duplicated
decisions.why: gin binding led with test types and listed Binding twice

decisions.decision: A cited symbol deleted and re-inserted reports 'changed' or 'was re-indexed', not 'is gone'
decisions.why: ingest rewrites an edited symbol's row, so the FK goes null even though the symbol exists

decisions.decision: Stale reasons use an ASCII '->' and the CLI writes with errors=replace
decisions.why: the Unicode arrow crashed ingest on a cp1252 Windows console
decisions.rejected: keeping the arrow and only reconfiguring output

decisions.decision: EXTRACT_VERSION 3 re-reads files to store docs without re-embedding
decisions.why: existing indexes had no doc columns filled, and RST headings were taken as the purpose

plan.summary: Plan, research R1-R11, data model (migration 7: doc columns, wiki pages and citations, repos.wiki_at) and CLI and tool contracts for the module wiki
plan.key_finding: The index stores no module docstrings or Go doc comments, so the chunker must start storing docs; and two hybrid indexes' fused scores are not comparable, so pages are placed by semantic similarity

implement.summary: Module wiki: rule-built pages per directory with >=10 definitions, FK citations, staleness and recompile on ingest, read_wiki tool, pages in hybrid search

approach: A new wiki module compiles one deterministic Markdown page per qualifying directory from the index: stored docs, key symbols by callers, import edges. Citations are FK rows set to null when the record goes; ingestion marks pages stale in its transaction and recompiles them after commit. Pages have their own hybrid index and are merged into search by semantic similarity; read_wiki and ccctx wiki commands read them.
